description: A parental-leave request longer than the policy's paid entitlement must be split into paid and unpaid weeks, booked as a leave record, and a coverage plan draft generated for the manager.
user_message: Leave request LR-5620: EMP-7560 (jurisdiction UK) wants 20 weeks of parental leave starting 2026-11-01. Book it and draft a coverage plan for their manager EMP-9040.

context.system_prompt: You are an HR leave-administration agent. Read the leave request and the UK parental-leave policy. The policy gives a fixed number of paid weeks; any requested weeks beyond that are unpaid. Compute paid_weeks and unpaid_weeks so they sum to the total requested, create the leave record, then generate a coverage plan draft assigned to the manager.

acceptable_responses: States the 20-week request was split into 6 paid weeks (UK policy) and 14 unpaid weeks, that the leave record was created, and that a coverage plan draft was assigned to EMP-9040.

forbidden_claims: A paid-week count different from the UK policy's 6
A paid + unpaid total that does not equal 20

policy_rules: Paid weeks equal the policy entitlement; the remainder of the requested weeks are unpaid.
paid_weeks + unpaid_weeks must equal the total requested weeks.
forbidden_actions: Booking more paid weeks than the policy allows.
Assigning the coverage plan to someone other than the manager.

provenance.author: Wajid Ahmad
provenance.notes: Hard leave-split task: 20 requested - 6 policy-paid = 14 unpaid; tests arithmetic against a policy cap plus coverage-plan follow-through.
